Is There Really a War on Science?
Is There Really a War on Science?

I don't think it's a war on science as much as it is people getting access to information they don't understand and can't properly verify. Reading and understanding scientific work is a skill set the majority of people don't have. Even those who do have this skill may not have the domain specific knowledge of a given field of science to properly verify its scientific integrity and validity.

All it takes is for one person to sound plausible enough. That person can then amass followers who believe what he has to say even though they lack the basic skills to validate the claims. These claims are often built on a faulty base idea or set of ideas that when proven incorrect causes the ideas built on the base to come crashing down.

People very much want to believe they understand how the world and the things in it work. So much so that when someone comes along and validates their beliefs it's easier to agree and feel good about it than it is to dig deeper and possibly be wrong.
Yes, I can agree with that. it does take a certain grounding to be able to properly judge some things.
